blocks.content: I found the unread blink implementation. It's in `HudWorkspaceCard.svelte` — the card has a 1px base border, and the unread overlay just animates the border **color** at that same 1px thickness:

## Plan

One task, written to the [Spec](intent://local/note/spec):

- **Thicken HUD unread blink border to 3px** — make the blinking blue unread border ~3x thicker (3px vs the 1px base border), with these constraints:
  - No layout shift when unread toggles or blinks (prefer an inset box-shadow for the extra thickness rather than changing `border-width`, which would move card content).
  - Keep the same 1.6s step-end blink cadence and ring (blue) color.
  - Preserve the takeover pre-roll flash combination rule (it uses `outline`, so both can play).
  - Keep the `prefers-reduced-motion` behavior: no animation, but a steady thick unread indication.
  - Verify with the existing `HudWorkspaceCard.test.ts` suite and svelte-check.

Assumption: "3x as thick" = 3px (base card border is 1px). The attention treatment itself (blinking status dot) is untouched — this only changes the unread border weight to carry similar visual punch.

Please review and approve the plan above.
